Rashi on Chullin 60a:1:1.english: Facing the sun - Facing the sun.

Rashi on Chullin 60a:2:1.english: That I prepare bread for Him - I will prepare a meal for Him.

Rashi on Chullin 60a:2:2.english: On the bank of the Revita - On the bank of a river whose name is Revita.

Rashi on Chullin 60a:2:3.hebrew: דרויח עלמא - להתקבץ שם חיילותיו, והוא נתכוין למקום שתהא רוח שולטת בו:
Rashi on Chullin 60a:2:3.english: Where the world is spacious - [Ostensibly,] for His hosts to gather there; but he intended a place where the wind would have dominion over it.

Rashi on Chullin 60a:2:4.english: Swept it into the sea - Swept it into the sea.

Rashi on Chullin 60a:3:1.english: Sweepers - Those who sweep the house.

Rashi on Chullin 60a:3:2.hebrew: זלוחאי - מרביצי הבית במים מפני אבק העולה, וכבר הם כלו לאכול כל זה:
Rashi on Chullin 60a:3:2.english: Sprinklers - Those who sprinkle the house with water because of the rising dust; and already they have finished eating all this.

Rashi on Chullin 60a:3:3.hebrew: אי הכי - דנפישי חיילותיו כ"כ, לא מצינא:
Rashi on Chullin 60a:3:3.english: If so - Since His legions are so numerous, I cannot [do so].

Rashi on Chullin 60a:4:1.english: A distaff - Desvolteires [a yarn winder, or reel], in Old French.
